description: Use when a merchant wants to compare genuinely avoidable monthly internal logistics expenses with the additional recurring expense of outsourcing the same operating scope. Include only changes: shared costs that remain equal are excluded from both sides. Optional transition costs determine a simple payback when monthly cash savings are positive. Founder time, speculative revenue and fixed costs that remain payable are not cash savings.

additionalOutsourcedMonthly.description: Additional recurring cash expenses caused by outsourcing, excluding common unchanged costs.

avoidableInternalMonthly.description: Monthly internal cash expenses that would actually cease after outsourcing.

transitionCost.description: One-off switching costs, if known; absence is not zero.

name: compare_warehouse_costs
title: Compare avoidable warehouse expenses with outsourcing
